answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded stake with correlated slashing. Each AI agent must lock a bond in a basalt ledger before its vote or payout counts, and identities are bound to that bond. If two are proven to be the same operator, every linked bond burns together. So each fake identity costs real capital: doubling Sybils doubles the locked stake, while one detected cluster forfeits the whole pile. A walnut stands for the tiny bond that still must be paid, and no saffron sheen of fresh accounts can dodge the slash.
